fun a1(a: u8, b: u8, c: u8) -> u8 { let p: u8 = a + b
 return p - (c + a) }

fixtures.name: a2

fun a2(a: u8, b: u8, c: u8, d: u8) -> u8 { let p: u8 = a - b
 return p + (c - d) }

fixtures.name: a4
